India Condemns Hormuz Vessel Attacks, Two Indian Seafarers Missing

Two commercial vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and Oman. India has condemned the strikes, with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) calling for an end to such attacks and de-escalation. Two Indian seafarers are reported missing following the incidents. The Embassy of India in Muscat is monitoring the situation and coordinating with Omani authorities and ship management companies for the rescue of the missing individuals and to assist the Indian crew.
